definition: spread out across the entire world
description: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

en.question: What is he doing in the snow?
